conclusion: The SU(3)_f content of the full 248 is exactly {1, 3, 3bar, 8}. The 8 (from (1,8), i.e. the SU(3)_f gauge bosons sitting inside E8's own adjoint) is not a new invariant-theory generator: 3 x 3bar = 1 + 8 means every octet component is already a traceless bilinear in a 3 and a 3bar. No representation beyond {1,3,3bar} (and their tensor combinations) is ever supplied by E8 at any point in the branching -- this holds for the FULL adjoint, not just the (27,3) matter piece Z39 tested.
